records.rationale: Retain bitmap-backed per-process Binder handle allocation through the previously reviewed IdPool. It preserves manager-only handle zero, acquires a bit only after both tree insertions succeed, releases it when the corresponding reference is removed, and detects a bitmap/tree mismatch without returning an occupied handle. Tree/node storage is reserved before locking; growth and shrink allocation release node_refs and revalidate after reacquisition. The second by_node lookup handles concurrent insertion, while the unused reservation has not set its bit. Shrink failure leaves a valid old bitmap. This avoids linear tree walks at increasing handle counts; no benchmark from the historical message was reproduced or adopted as SDK evidence.
